acceptance: Journey, red first: a resumed build goes from 5 findings to 1, gets a further correction, and the floor passes.
The same finding twice ends the cycle as today, and the digest names its class.
The bound is in policy, with no flag and no env read.
A round emits a signal with the counts before and after.
Docs: the spec section of the floor in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: When a floor rejection after a correction holds fewer findings than the one before, or other findings, and each is deterministic with a prescribed fix, allow one more correction, with a stated bound. Repeating the same findings stops as today. Record each round in a signal.
source: Wave 154, 2026-11-04. Cycle 2146: 5 floor findings, then 1 (a function 1 line over its size ceiling). Cycle 2149: failing tests, then 1 (one unnamed export). Each was rejected after 1 correction, and the cycle ended. Convergence policy ADR-0126 says converge or escalate; these runs converged. Operator rule: cost against output, and small prescribed findings get fixed in session.
summary: A build that goes from 5 floor findings to 1 ends after one correction, and the cycle is lost over a one-line fix.
title: The build floor allows another correction while its findings converge
